3. **[QTE/GBQTEComponent.cpp:134](C:/GameJam/Glyphbound/Source/Glyphbound/QTE/GBQTEComponent.cpp:134), [Spells/GBSpellbookComponent.cpp:487](C:/GameJam/Glyphbound/Source/Glyphbound/Spells/GBSpellbookComponent.cpp:487)** — `CancelQTE()` finishes using the accumulated score, so cancellation succeeds if any step was correct. Death calls this after cancelling sustained spells, allowing a new projectile, wall, or shield to spawn from the dead player; make cancellation return an unsuccessful result and reject cast completion when the owner is dead.

4. **[World/GBEraSubsystem.cpp:172](C:/GameJam/Glyphbound/Source/Glyphbound/World/GBEraSubsystem.cpp:172)** — Travel continues if the player dies during the fade, then `RestoreAll()` revives them and saves over the checkpoint while the death menu and scheduled respawn remain active. The player can revive inside an ongoing death flow and then be restored again; cancel pending travel on death and guard restoration against a dead traveller.

5. **[World/GBEraComponent.cpp:108](C:/GameJam/Glyphbound/Source/Glyphbound/World/GBEraComponent.cpp:108)** — Hiding an enemy disables its actor tick and movement tick, but leaves attribute and status-effect components ticking. Burning enemies can die, drop rewards, and advance encounters while their era is inactive, and regeneration continues invisibly; suspend those component ticks while absent and restore their previous settings on return.

6. **[Combat/GBCombatLibrary.cpp:126](C:/GameJam/Glyphbound/Source/Glyphbound/Combat/GBCombatLibrary.cpp:126)** — Radial damage checks distance but never checks obstruction. Fireballs, grenades, and runes damage enemies through solid walls and ice-wall cover; add an obstruction trace before applying each target’s radial damage.

7. **[AI/GBEnemyCharacter.cpp:477](C:/GameJam/Glyphbound/Source/Glyphbound/AI/GBEnemyCharacter.cpp:477)** — Enemy melee attacks check only distance before dealing damage. An orc within reach can hit the player through an ice wall or thin level geometry; require an unobstructed trace to the player before applying the melee hit.

Enchanting a gun and switching weapons therefore grants the enchant’s damage bonus to weapons that should not receive it; introduce a gun-only modifier key and use it for the three enchant effects.

The future encounter’s two-magazine reward disappears completely when only one spare-magazine slot is free; return the count actually accepted so the pickup retains its remainder.

4. Era travel while dying: `PerformSwap` returns early when the traveller is dead (player or attribute check) — era unchanged, no teleport, no `RestoreAll`, no `SaveCheckpoint` (`World/GBEraSubsystem.cpp/.h`).
5. Other-era simulation freeze: `UGBEraComponent::ApplyPresence` now disables tick on every ticking component of the owner (remembered in `SavedTickComponents`) and re-enables exactly those on return; movement tick is restored from the same saved set (`World/GBEraComponent.h/.cpp`).
6. Explosions blocked by walls: `DealRadialDamage` traces `ECC_Visibility` from the origin lifted 5 cm to each target, ignoring the target and `IgnoreActors`; a blocking hit on another actor skips the target (`Combat/GBCombatLibrary.cpp`).
7. Melee needs sight: melee branch of `PerformAttack` now requires `HasLineOfSight(Goal)` (`AI/GBEnemyCharacter.cpp`).
8. Slot-wide gun enchant: added `GBStat::WeaponSlotKey` (`Core/GBStatNames.h`, includes `Core/GBTypes.h`); `AGBHeldItem::GetStat` evaluates `Weapon.<Id>`, `Weapon.<Slot>`, `Weapon.All` (`Weapons/GBHeldItem.cpp/.h`); the three `Enchant_*` effects use `Weapon.Gun.Damage` (`Content/Data/StatusEffects.json`); modifier-key docs updated (`Design/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `FGBModifierDef::Stat` in `Data/GBDataTypes.h`).
9. Ammo remainder kept: `AddItem` (Ammo) returns `UsedAmmoItems(added, perItem)` (ceil division), new pure static helper on the component (`Items/GBInventoryComponent.h/.cpp`); `AGBPickup::GiveDrop` already keeps the remainder from the return value.
10a. Arena always built: `InitGame` builds `AGBTestArena` when no arena exists AND (no `APlayerStart` OR package starts with `/Engine/`, via `RemovePIEPrefix`); arena stores its `APlayerStart` (new getter) and `ChoosePlayerStart_Implementation` returns it (`Core/GBGameMode.h/.cpp`, `World/GBTestArena.h/.cpp`).
10b. Gun viewmodel: pistol parts moved forward of the anchor into a compact ~29 cm pistol (body 20, barrel 9), neon strip on the camera-facing (-Y) side, whole viewmodel yawed -6 deg toward view center (`Weapons/GBGun.cpp`). Screenshots `2_past_gun`/`3_future_gun` now show a dark pistol with cyan accent in the lower right, barrel toward the crosshair.
10c. Smoke review: start enemies=2, Z=92.15 on the floor; `hit enemy TrainingDummy ... dead=1`; after travel era=Future with 100/100 HP and MP; after respawn alive in Future with 100/100, staff in hand and learned spells (FireWall, Flamethrower) still in the loadout, skill unlock kept.
Tests: added `Glyphbound.Stats.WeaponSlotKeys` (slot-key naming, `Tests/GBStatsTests.cpp`) and `Glyphbound.Items.AmmoRemainder` (ceil-division helper, new `Tests/GBInventoryTests.cpp`). 22 tests, 0 failed.

3. Unsure / not fully verifiable
- Fixes 2, 4, 5, 7 involve world collision/AI and cannot be covered by pure-logic tests per the rules; verified by code reading and by the smoke run (which does not shoot walls, die mid-travel, strand burning enemies cross-era, or melee through walls). In particular fix 2 relies on the projectile's overlap response pairing with the wall's newly enabled overlap events; both the blocking-hit and overlap paths in `AGBProjectile` damage Neutral walls and stop, but I could not exercise it in-game.
- `RespawnAt` intentionally does not clear spell cooldowns (the old `LoadFromSnapshot` path did); the decision did not mention cooldowns, so they now persist through death.
- Fix 10b is aesthetic judgment; the result looks sane in screenshots but a person should glance at `2_past_gun.png` to confirm.
